ablation: unsigned residual-correlation migration using the same state and allocator
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: A-H research/development evidence is already observed. Frontier-I is another development research look, not a fresh holdout. 2023+ excluded from selection.
cost_hypothesis: weekly rebalance and structural graph state should keep target persistence materially above daily signal noise
failure_mode: mechanism collapses into ordinary unsigned topology migration, static isolation, generic residual trend, or another occupied family
falsifier: rotate signed migration assignments across eligible identities
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Designed after A-H development evidence. Frontier-I changes graph mathematics rather than retuning topology_migration_w84. No public performance claim is inherited.
stop_rule: freeze if falsifier or ablation matches/beats canonical base or if every valid base cell is below the fixed development floor; no post-look formula rescue
thesis: Assets that shed positive residual links while retaining or gaining negative residual links during fragmentation capture a distinct decoupling phase.
timing: completed daily bars only; fixed 21-day prior graph comparison; evaluator owns execution lag
validation: 2023-2024 remains untouched during development selection; 2025+ diagnostic/live evidence never drives mutation
